payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort the array, compute element-wise absolute difference with original, count zeros; if zero count >= n-2 (at most two mismatches), answer YES else NO.
payload.rationale: The solution relies on sorting and comparing elements; it doesn't use a custom key, binary search, or sweep line. sorting_custom_key is the most appropriate among provided candidates as a catch-all for sorting-based solutions.
